## 7. Long-Term Operating Cost Drivers

For Ti-6Al-4V aerospace work, **CAPEX is not the dominant lifecycle cost** — tooling, scrap, coolant, and spindle events are. In rough order of cost weight:

1. **Tooling consumption (largest variable cost).** At typical Ti-6Al-4V roughing parameters, insert life is measured in minutes. Rigidity, chatter resistance, and thermal stability directly set insert life; HPC optimization is the biggest lever (§2). All three machines accept Capto C6 (NLX via BMT adapters — verify), enabling shared tool inventories across a multi-machine fleet.
2. **Scrap from thermal drift.** Each scrapped Ti-6Al-4V billet represents **$200–$2,000+ in raw material alone**, before machine time. Okuma's <10 µm TFC stability and DMG MORI's 7 µm documented continuous-operation displacement directly reduce dimensional-check frequency and scrap; Mazak's adaptive system needs validation on your parts.
3. **Spindle replacement (typically 1× per 4–7 years at high duty).** **DMG MORI's 36-month, unlimited-spindle-hours warranty on Gen 2 MASTER spindles is unique among the three** and directly underwrites the 3-shift/high-utilization interpretation of your 15,000-hour requirement ([dmgmori.com NLX 2500 2nd Gen](https://en.dmgmori.com/products/machines/turning/universal-turning/nlx/nlx-2500-2nd)).
4. **Coolant and consumables.** A documented case study put coolant cost at **~$22,000/yr/machine before optimization** (Quaker Houghton HOCUT 4940 case, [home.quakerhoughton.com](https://home.quakerhoughton.com)); DMG MORI offers zero-sludgeCOOLANT pro; Mazak SmartBox analytics monitor coolant life.
5. **Energy.** DMG MORI claims **16% energy savings via GREENMODE** options; Okuma's **ECO suite plus** auto-manages idling/cooling ("the machine itself decides when to cool and stop idling" — [okuma.com](https://www.okuma.com/cnc-osp-p500)); Mazak is comparable class without a published figure.
6. **Connectivity/data infrastructure.** DMG MORI includes IoT Connector + CELOS X standard; Okuma's MTConnect adapter is free (OPC-UA depends on control variant); **Mazak SmartBox 2.0 is a paid accessory**. Shops using data-driven optimization report **20–30% cost reductions** via setup consolidation and optimized feeds/speeds ([precisionam.com](https://www.precisionam.com)).
7. **Obsolescence and parts risk over 10–15 years.** **Okuma is a single-source manufacturer of mechanics, motors, encoders, spindles, and controls** — the strongest protection against orphaned components. **The Mazak i-400S's discontinued status is the inverse risk** — verify build status or pivot to the i NEO. DMG MORI's MASTER spindle platform is common across the NLX line.
8. **Service contract/response time.** All three are local (§6); negotiate response-time SLAs and local parts stocking given your utilization.
9. **CAM/post licensing.** DMG MORI MTSK is the most integrated with NX (support included via DMG MORI Digital); Mazak bundles **Smooth CAM Ai and 3 years of free Mazatrol training**; Okuma's MTConnect/App Store model is lowest-cost but requires more integrator effort for NX depth.
10. **Facility costs (often overlooked).** The i-400S at **16.2 t vs. the NLX at ~6.4 t** implies materially different foundation, rigging, and floor-loading costs; HPC plumbing adds **$30–60k installed per machine**; titanium's stringy, hot, reactive chips demand appropriate conveyor/scraper design and fire-risk management regardless of platform.

## 8. Recommendation by Use Case

| Decision factor | DMG MORI NLX 2500SY (Gen 2) | Mazak Integrex i-400S | Okuma Multus U4000 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Heavy chucked Ti shaft/flange turning | ★★★★★ (1,273 Nm w/ 12") | ★★★★★ (1,400 Nm) | ★★★★☆ (955 Nm opt.) |
| Complex 5-axis prismatic Ti parts | ★★★☆☆ (mill-turn, ≤100 Nm milling) | ★★★★★ (B-axis, 120 Nm, largest envelope) | ★★★★★ (B-axis 120 Nm + 300 mm Y) |
| Holding ±0.0005" in real shop ambient | ★★★★☆ (7 µm documented) | ★★★★☆ (adaptive, unquantified) | ★★★★★ (<10 µm over ±8 °C, JSME award) |
| Siemens NX CAM integration | ★★★★★ (vendor-certified MTSK) | ★★★★☆ (Post Hub SMKS) | ★★★★☆ (Post Hub + THINC) |
| AS9100D traceability | ★★★★★ (TDE tool lineage, all protocols standard) | ★★★★☆ (SmartBox 2.0, best cybersecurity) | ★★★★☆ (Connect Plan most turnkey) |
| Nuevo León service | ★★★★☆ (Apodaca; parts in Querétaro) | ★★★★★ (Technology Center + 3-yr training) | ★★★★★ (HEMAQ since 1989, AS9100D-certified) |
| High-utilization risk coverage | ★★★★★ (36-mo unlimited spindle hrs) | ★★★☆☆ | ★★★☆☆ |
| Platform longevity | ★★★★☆ | ★★☆☆☆ (verify status / i NEO) | ★★★★★ (single-source) |

- **Chucked titanium shafts, flanges, and short mill-turn work in an NX-standardized digital shop → DMG MORI NLX 2500SY 2nd Generation.** Best-in-class turning torque with the 12" option (1,273 Nm), documented 7 µm continuous thermal performance, the deepest Siemens NX pipeline (MTSK + CSE + technology-cycle simulation), OPC-UA/MTConnect/MQTT standard, and the unique 36-month unlimited-hours spindle warranty that directly underwrites aggressive utilization.
- **Large, complex prismatic titanium structural parts in one-setup DONE-IN-ONE operations → Mazak Integrex i-400S — but only after written confirmation of build status**, otherwise evaluate the **Integrex i NEO**. Highest peak torque (1,400 Nm), largest envelope and mass (16.2 t), 120 Nm milling spindle, full Technology Center support in Apodaca with 3 years of free training.
- **Mixed shaft + 5-axis contouring work under variable shop temperatures, with AS9100D audit exposure → Okuma Multus U4000 with the high-torque (955 Nm) spindle option.** The strongest all-round thermal-stability evidence (<10 µm, ambient-tolerant, JSME-validated), 7×-rigidity bed claim, largest Y-travel, single-source long-term parts security, and the only AS9100D-certified local service partner (HEMAQ, 4,000+ installations since 1989).

**For the 15,000-hour fleet interpretation specifically:** standardizing 3–4 machines on one platform multiplies the value of shared Capto C6 tooling, common posts, common operator skills, and consolidated service contracts. On that basis, the **Okuma Multus U4000 (high-torque option)** is the strongest all-round fleet platform for mixed titanium work in Nuevo León, with the **DMG MORI NLX 2500SY Gen 2** the better choice if the mix is dominated by chucked shaft/flange turning and NX-driven digital thread.

## 9. Open Items to Resolve With Each OEM in Writing

1. Exact spindle package and duty-cycle-rated torque curves (especially the Mazak 500 Nm vs. 1,400 Nm ambiguity, and NLX Gen 1 vs. Gen 2).
2. Integrex i-400S build/discontinuation status; if unclear, quote the i NEO.

4. HPC system spec (pressure, filtration, through-spindle rating) and installed plumbing cost.
5. Acceptance-test protocol on your Ti-6Al-4V parts demonstrating ±0.0005" under your actual shop ambient conditions, with thermal-compensation data logged.
6. Guaranteed service response times, local spindle/parts stocking commitments, and multi-machine fleet pricing for the 3–4-machine interpretation of the 15,000-hour requirement.
